meta.author: dustycompiler
meta.cadence: GitHub Actions snapshot (not a guaranteed 15-minute tick; cron can drift or pause). STALE banner if snapshot age > 2 hours. On-page LIVE pulse: browser JSON-RPC to public Solana RPC (publicnode, mainnet-beta fallback) for slot/epoch/TPS at most every 60s. Snapshot values shown as NOT LIVE if RPC fails. Never invented.

live_pulse.label: LIVE / on-page-now vs snapshot generated_at
live_pulse.fail: NOT LIVE — last snapshot values; never invented
live_pulse.note: Browser JSON-RPC. publicnode first because api.mainnet-beta.solana.com 403s GitHub Pages Origin; publicnode CORS *. Same two keyless endpoints as generate.py. At most every 60s. Not a GitHub Actions tick.

dex.change_7d_meaning: percent change of 24h DEX volume vs the 24h from 7 days ago (not 7d-total vs prior 7d)

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.0010 SOL over 1s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 0 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 1 slots spread over a ~0.0h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=160 all-tx, n_nonvote=64, window_seconds=1. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=160 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 1s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 0 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 1 slots spread over a ~0.0h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=160 all-tx, n_nonvote=64, window_seconds=1. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=160 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 1s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.

jito.tips_24h_note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00001450 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1218) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 153197 USD; at p95 floor → 2004546 USD.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 153197 USD; at p95 floor → 2004546 USD.

jito_runrate_not_rev.note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00001450 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1218) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito_runrate_not_rev.label: INVALID as a 24h aggregate — tip_floor is per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx

economics.rev_definition: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV.
economics.rev_kind: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-09-13: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-09-13
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 153197 USD; at p95 floor → 2004546 USD.

rev_components.label: Jito tip-floor run-rate (NOT REV)
rev_components.source: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00001450 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1218) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
INVALID as a 24h aggregate — sensitivity only, not headline REV
INVALID sensitivity only, not summed into REV
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV
MEASURED Jito gross MEV tips UTC day (jito_tips+validator_tips)

economics.total_rev_note: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV. Protocol fees 13548091.579999998 USD are listed separately and excluded.
economics.rev_spot_note: spot equivalent at this run SOL-USD; not the headline REV USD

items.title:
RT by @anza_xyz: Transactions V1 is now live on Solana, increasing max transaction sizes from 1,232 to 4,096 bytes. 

Complex operations like ZK proofs, large multisigs, and confidential transfers that required multiple transactions now fit in one.

Full details from @anza_xyz: https://x.com/anza_xyz/status/2099665631415341253

items.title:
Indexers, paymasters, and anyone reading priority fees: read transactionConfig instead of ComputeBudget instructions. Compute budget instructions are ignored for configuration in V1, so scanning them may return zero or misleading values for V1 transactions.

RPC operators: run v4.2.2 or v4.3.0-beta.3 to serve the larger size.
items.summary: Indexers, paymasters, and anyone reading priority fees: read transactionConfig instead of ComputeBudget instructions. Compute budget instructions are ignored for configuration in V1, so scanning them may return zero or misleading values for V1 transactions. RPC operators: run v4.
items.creator: @anza_xyz

items.title:
Sending transactions for V1 is opt-in. Legacy and V0 remain supported while existing apps continue working as is.

Reading V1 transactions is not opt-in. If you read blocks or transactions over RPC, pass maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 1 on getTransaction, getBlock, and blockSubscribe. Without it, one V1 transaction fails the entire call.

items.title:
Transaction V1 (SIMD-0385) is live on mainnet-beta.

Max transaction size grows from 1,232 to 4,096 bytes. ZK proofs, large multisigs, BLS signatures, and confidential transfers that required multiple transactions now fit in one atomic operation.

V1 also moves resource requests (compute unit limit, priority fee, loaded accounts data size, heap size) into the transaction header instead of compute budget instructions.

gates.method: getAccountInfo Feature accounts (encoding=base64). effective_epoch = epoch(activated_slot) + 1. Observed mean slot is corroboration only — never gate proof.

editorial.summary: First-party Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.” On-chain Feature accounts: 400ms=superseded, 350ms=live, 300ms=live, 250ms=pending, 200ms=pending. Observed mean slot ~315 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. Alpenglow (SIMD-0326) remains the consensus rewrite (Votor / Rotor); it is a separate track from the slot-time feature gates.

timeline_public.item: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.”
solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” remains a listing-token write-up for SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Observed mean slot ~315 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether the 300 ms gate (effective epoch 1024 when activated at epoch-1023 start) is live once that epoch starts.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (250/200) get Feature accounts on mainnet.
Do not treat observed slot ms as activation proof.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.

Time-stratified getBlock sample: 0 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 1 slots spread over a ~0.0h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=160 all-tx, n_nonvote=64, window_seconds=1. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=160 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 1s.
